## About
RMACC Hose Co began by making A/C hoses for import cars at our shop in Glendale, a suburb of Phoenix. Over time we grew into repairs for all makes, plus power steering hoses, engine and transmission cooler lines, and new brake hoses and hard lines.
Owner Brian Brown and the crew stock a good selection of A/C parts, fittings, oils and tools, and we build custom lines for special applications and modern restorations. We like talking with people and helping them sort out their problems, and when we sell a compressor we walk you through what you need to do.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 139 Google reviews, and many of them mention Brian by name.

## Services
- A/C parts sales: New and remanufactured compressors, accumulators, dryers, expansion valves and orifice tubes, plus A/C flush, oils, dyes, special fittings and tools in stock.
- Custom A/C hoses: New custom fit A/C hoses and components, along with A/C hose repair.
- Brake hoses and hard lines: New brake hoses and hard lines, OE or custom, in rubber or stainless. Colored stainless comes in red, black, blue and gray.
- Power steering hoses: Custom fit power steering hoses and fittings, plus repairs on existing hoses.
- Transmission cooler lines: We rebuild transmission cooler lines along with A/C and power steering hoses.
- Hydraulic tube bending: Hydraulic tube bending and metal forming on our Tubes N Hoses equipment.
- Aluminum welding: Torch welding for pipes into blocks, pipes into pipes, and most pure aluminum parts.

## FAQ
Q: Can I ship you a hose instead of coming in?
A: Yes. If a hose is hard to find or the dealer lead time is too long, ship it to us and we'll repair it and ship it back.

Q: Can you help me track down a hard-to-find part?
A: Give us a call. We'll do our best to find it, or we may be able to make one for you.

Q: What can you weld in aluminum?
A: We torch weld pipes into blocks, pipes into pipes, and nearly anything that is pure aluminum. We can't weld aluminum castings.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No, we're closed Saturday and Sunday. Stop by or call during the week.
